title: A Murder in the Skies
summary: Neville is on a plane and is suspicious when a passenger disappears and everyone else on the plane deny seeing him. The passenger is later found shot dead on a beach in Saint Marie.
method: The victim paid everyone off on the plane to let him off the plane and to deny seeing him. He then went to a beach where he was shot.
motive: The victim had been having an affair with his wife and stole money.
killer: A friend of the victim that he was staying with
notes:
DI Parker and Florence’s last episode. This is the only relationship between a DI and DS that had a good ending because Humphrey/Camille and Richard/Camille didn’t work out.
Everyone on the plane gaslighting Neville didn’t make sense. Why did the victim pay them off in the first place? Also they should be charged for lying to a police officer.
I thought the airport would’ve had CCTV showing the passenger getting on the plane.
